defects: Plan has no required phase table, no explicit build-vs-verifier placement for `bun install`, and no target-environment control. Installing during verifier phase cannot fetch packages because verifier container runs with Docker network `none`; install must be specified and proved in build phase, where network policy differs.

Plan lacks runtime-file inventory and real target-runtime control. Proposed test command can pass against fixture fake Docker without proving generated image contains lockfile, installed dependencies, Bun binary, and verifier inputs needed by isolated container.
